question: Do direct base-60 bytes from the 256 LP2-49–51 grid entries produce full ASCII or UTF-8 text, or a declared PNG, gzip, ZIP or zlib header, under 16 fixed rectangular routes and all ten I/l stem choices?
scope: Use the wiki 256-entry grid in page order as one 32 by 8 rectangle. Convert each two-character token to one byte. The only transcription variants toggle the ten I/l cells from the pinned stem audit; all other cells, including 2S, remain fixed.
byte_rule: 60 times first digit plus second digit; require integer 0-255; no wrapping, padding or XOR.
routes: For row-major and column-major separately, choose outer-axis direction forward or reverse, initial inner-axis direction forward or reverse, and constant or alternating inner-axis direction after each outer row/column. This gives 2*2*2*2=16 routes; every route emits all 256 cells exactly once.
stem_variants: All 2^10=1024 I/l assignments from the pinned ten-stem coordinate register; mask bit i selects lowercase l at stem i, otherwise uppercase I.

screens.ASCII: All 256 bytes are tab, LF, CR or printable 0x20-0x7e.
screens.UTF-8: Python strict UTF-8 decoder accepts the entire 256-byte stream, regardless of linguistic content.
screens.zlib: First two bytes satisfy RFC 1950 CM=8, CINFO<=7, and (CMF*256+FLG) modulo 31 equals zero; this is a header screen, not decompression.

decision: Enumerate every route and stem mask with no adaptation; retain each stream hash and screen outcome. Report hits as format candidates requiring validation, not as decoded files. A null excludes only this direct, header-at-offset-zero model.
controls: Synthetic 256-byte ASCII text and injected PNG/gzip/ZIP/zlib headers must trigger their matching screens. Every route must be a permutation of 0..255 and have a distinct declared parameter tuple.
excluded: Other glyph changes, other digit alphabets or bases, 16x16 or geometric reflow, offsets inside a stream, added or removed bytes, XOR/other transforms, raw DEFLATE, unknown formats, partially readable text, and any encrypted or compressed payload lacking the declared header.
